data.title: check passw@rd
data.statement: Determine the strength of a password.
data.constraints:
A password earns 1 point for each rule it satisfies:

Length is at least 12 characters.
Contains at least one lowercase letter.
Contains at least one uppercase letter.
Contains at least one digit.
Contains at least one special character.
Does not contain any of these common passwords:
password
admin
azerty
qwerty
1234
data.outputDescription:
Line 1: The password strength: WEAK, MEDIUM or STRONG.
WEAK score (0 to 3)
MEDIUM score (4 to 5) 
STRONG score  (6 ++ )

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Determine the strength of a password.
Input
Line 1: A string password.
Output
Line 1: The password strength: WEAK, MEDIUM or STRONG.
WEAK score (0 to 3)
MEDIUM score (4 to 5)
STRONG score (6 ++ )
Constraints
A password earns 1 point for each rule it satisfies:

Length is at least 12 characters.
Contains at least one lowercase letter.
Contains at least one uppercase letter.
Contains at least one digit.
Contains at least one special character.
Does not contain any of these common passwords:
password
admin
azerty
qwerty
1234
Example
Input
password
Output
WEAK
